brief: The history of the bicycle in about 20 seconds: four dates (1817, 1885, 1970, 2020), one short line each, ending on "Still the best machine".
notes: The measured year-overlaps-line warning showed on every act (the huge 18-unit year sat on top of its caption and the red rule cut through the digits), so I separated each pair vertically — rule just under the number, caption a clear ~4 units below it. The check flagged all four captions at ~11 px (unreadable) and the 18:3 size jump was too steep, so I lifted the caption size from 3 to 5 (now ~18 px, a clean 3.6x hierarchy). To kill the four 2-second dead holds I added a gentle one-cycle float on each year during its hold. I left the strong final 'Still the best machine' payoff untouched.
